name: agent-surface
title: AgentSurface
description: Opt-in, placement-neutral renderer for v0.9 A2UI command envelopes (A2UI_VERSION). Pass an immutable messages log and a trusted catalog; append createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel and deleteSurface messages. Component records have id, component, optional children (child ids), and flat catalog properties; the root id is "root". Text/Heading/Badge use text; Text optionally accepts href; Heading accepts level 1–6. Card contains children; Stack accepts direction (row/column) and gap (0–12). Button uses label, optional disabled and action { name, context }; Input uses label, optional text value/disabled and only type text. Select uses label, options [{ value, label }], optional value/disabled; Checkbox uses label, optional checked/disabled. Alert uses title and optional text. { path: "/user/name" } reads a JSON Pointer; Input/Select value and Checkbox checked write back to that path. updateDataModel { surfaceId, path?, value } replaces the value at path (default: model root). Buttons, keyboard activation and implicit form submission emit onAction { name, surfaceId, context } with the current bound values. Replacing the log replays it; keep existing message objects stable when appending. Runtime validation rejects unsupported versions, malformed JSON, prototype keys, cycles, shared children and excessive trees (256 nodes, depth 32, 32 surfaces). Missing child definitions may arrive later. Unknown components and invalid properties show a localized placeholder and report a deduplicated onError diagnostic. The visible, accessible agent-content frame cannot be relabelled by the agent. Delete restores focus to the next surviving sibling control, a textarea composer, or the labelled container. defineAgentCatalog accepts trusted host wrappers { component, validate }; validate must return a fresh allow-list of known properties or null. Wrappers receive { props, children, onValueChange, onAction } and must assign explicit kit props. Never spread agent data into elements. Recognized URL properties reuse Markdown safeUrl; text renders as React text nodes. Custom catalogs can reintroduce phishing and executable content: audit their wrappers and validators, never allow passwords, payments, file uploads, arbitrary markup or host-chrome styling. Transport, side-panel placement, v0.8 adapters and Markdown integration belong to consumers or future changes. The live example demonstrates every default entry, model patches, actions, rejection, deletion and reset.
author: gntik-ai

import { interpolate, useI18n, type MessageKey, type MessageVars } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

/**
 * English fallbacks for the chat keys added after the first `@gntik-ai/ui` release. The
 * strings live in the ui catalogs (en + es); these keep the pack readable when it runs
 * against an older `@gntik-ai/ui` whose catalog does not have them yet.
 */
const FALLBACK = {
  'chat.surfaceExampleTitle': 'Review your details',
  'chat.surfaceExampleName': 'Name',
  'chat.surfaceExampleSubmit': 'Submit',
  'chat.surfaceExampleChoice': 'Language',
  'chat.surfaceExampleEnglish': 'English',
  'chat.surfaceExampleSpanish': 'Spanish',
  'chat.surfaceExampleNotify': 'Send updates',
  'chat.surfaceExampleBadge': 'Draft',
  'chat.surfaceExampleNotice': 'Check the information before submitting.',
  'chat.surfaceExampleStatus': 'Submitted for {name}',
  'chat.surfaceExamplePatch': 'Update name',
  'chat.surfaceExampleRemove': 'Remove content',
  'chat.surfaceExampleReset': 'Reset',
  'chat.surfaceExampleUnsupported': 'Show unsupported content',
  'chat.surfaceExampleRejected': 'Unsupported content was rejected.',
  'chat.surfaceExampleLink': 'Read the documentation',
  'chat.surfaceUnsupported': 'This content cannot be shown',
  'chat.surfaceAgentContent': 'Agent content',
  'chat.typing': '{author} is typing',
  'chat.feedback': 'Response feedback',
  'chat.feedbackTitle': 'What went wrong?',
  'chat.feedbackReason': 'Reason',
  'chat.feedbackComment': 'Comment (optional)',
  'chat.feedbackPlaceholder': 'Tell us more…',
  'chat.feedbackSubmit': 'Send feedback',
  'chat.feedbackThanks': 'Thanks for your feedback',
  'chat.feedbackCleared': 'Feedback removed',
  'chat.reasonInaccurate': 'Inaccurate',
  'chat.reasonUnhelpful': 'Not helpful',
  'chat.reasonIncomplete': 'Incomplete',
  'chat.reasonUnsafe': 'Harmful or unsafe',
  'chat.reasonOther': 'Other',
  'chat.regenerate': 'Regenerate',
  'chat.uploading': 'Uploading {name}',
  'chat.uploadFailed': 'Upload failed',
  'chat.retryUpload': 'Retry uploading {name}',
  'chat.dropFiles': 'Drop files to attach',
  'chat.fileTooLarge': '{name} is larger than {max}',
  'chat.fileTypeNotAllowed': '{name} is not an allowed file type',
  'chat.tooManyFiles': 'You can attach up to {max} files',
  'chat.model': 'Model',
  'chat.selectModel': 'Select a model',
  'chat.capabilityVision': 'Vision',
  'chat.capabilityTools': 'Tools',
  'chat.capabilityReasoning': 'Reasoning',
  'chat.capabilityFiles': 'Files',
  'chat.capabilityWeb': 'Web search',
  'chat.capabilityAudio': 'Audio',
  'chat.contextWindow': '{size} context',
  'chat.unavailable': 'Unavailable',
} as const;

export type ChatMessageKey = keyof typeof FALLBACK;

/** `useI18n()` plus `tc()`, a translator for the newer chat keys with English fallbacks. */
export function useChatI18n() {
  const i18n = useI18n();
  const tc = (key: ChatMessageKey, vars?: MessageVars) => {
    const out = i18n.t(key as MessageKey, vars);
    return out === key ? interpolate(FALLBACK[key], vars, i18n.locale) : out;
  };
  return { ...i18n, tc };
}
